summary: Review validation studies by attacking the reference measurement, construct boundary, repeatability and transportability before judging a proxy or model.

must_inspect.why: A proxy cannot be strongly validated against a reference whose quantity, error, stability or boundary is insufficiently characterized.
false_positive_guards: A reference need not be perfect; the manuscript must justify that its limitations are compatible with the claimed inference.

must_inspect.why: Agreement on an observable does not establish validity for a broader latent construct without an explicit bridge.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand latent-construct validation when the claim is explicitly limited to the observable quantity.

must_inspect.why: Within-condition fit can mask instability across devices, operators, environments or time.
false_positive_guards: Do not call a deliberately local calibration non-generalizable as a defect when the claim remains local.
Attack the reference before the proxy, but do not require unattainable metrology when the claim is modest.
handoff_triggers: External standard or instrument facts -> evidence-researcher
